boundary: Author-supplied tiny models, probabilities, schedules and checkpoint windows. No vendor model, GPU training, throughput measurement or benchmark replication.

mtp.normalization: Mean over valid positions separately for each head, then weighted sum. Empty heads contribute zero; targets never cross a record boundary.
mtp.architecture: A scalar causal trunk h_t=theta*embedding[token_t] and two independent linear heads with two logits. No attention or Transformer.

boosting.boundary: One fixed prefix, frozen teacher probabilities, two trainable logits. No hidden-state mixing or real rollout collection.

wsd.decay: Linear teaching schedule, not NVIDIA minus-sqrt decay emulation.
wsd.selection: Both steps and both merge windows/coefficients fixed before computing results; no best-window selection.

publishedIntervals.boundary: Independent statements from the 2026-04-03 Super report and official recipe commit 99a7e45; their cause is not inferred.

klVersusAcceptance.purpose: Constructed probability counterexample, not a sampled dataset or a gradient-update trajectory.
